items.title: What if AI agents shared solutions across users?
items.summary: I’m debugging my app, reporting problems to an AI, and the AI fixes them so I can move to the next step. My app is a kind of wrapper, so I believe tens of thousands of developers are probably going through similar debugging steps. I wonder what would happen if AI agents could exchange what their users are struggling with and how those problems were solved. Our problem-solving speed might increase significantly. A bug I am struggling with may already have been solved by someone else. If AI agents could communicate with each other and find that solution, they might provide a shortcut instead of solving the same problem again. Of course, there are serious privacy concerns. We might need another AI or privacy layer to decide what can be safely shared. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49191535 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
items.summary_html:
I’m debugging my app, reporting problems to an AI, and the AI fixes them so I can move to the next step.

My app is a kind of wrapper, so I believe tens of thousands of developers are probably going through similar debugging steps.

I wonder what would happen if AI agents could exchange what their users are struggling with and how those problems were solved. Our problem-solving speed might increase significantly.

A bug I am struggling with may already have been solved by someone else. If AI agents could communicate with each other and find that solution, they might provide a shortcut instead of solving the same problem again.

Of course, there are serious privacy concerns. We might need another AI or privacy layer to decide what can be safely shared.
